versions.short: The bill would let the Secretary of Transportation set up a nonprofit corporation under New York law to support the athletic programs of the United States Merchant Marine Academy. The corporation would be able to receive funds, supplies, and services, and the Department of Transportation could transfer assets from an existing support fund to it, while leasing academy property to it for up to 5 years. The bill would also let the Secretary license the academy's trademarks and service marks and keep those fees to pay for licensing costs and for athletic and recruiting programs. Department employees could serve on the corporation's board in an oversight role, without pay beyond travel expenses, and the bill would require guidance on the trademark licensing program within 180 days of enactment.
